item.title: The Ballroom Dance Doesn't Belong in Court
item.description: The Supreme Court correctly avoided intervening in the dispute between Trump and Congress over ballroom renovations.

item.title: U.N. highlights nuclear states' refusal to ratify test ban treaty amid tensions
item.description: The United Nations draws attention to the fact that nuclear-armed nations like the U.S., Russia, and China have not ratified the treaty banning atomic tests.

item.title: Economics Alone Isn't the Whole Story
item.description: A full economic argument must also consider what economic freedom enables people to create.

item.title: DeSantis orders removal of Flock cameras from Florida state roads
item.description: Responding to public criticism, Florida Governor Ron DeSantis has directed that pole-mounted license plate readers be taken down from state roads.
